style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: amber glass containers that hold water: warm orange keys with dark ink and a watermelon-pink Enter, a treat of the same kitchen world (never red, never violet)

images.object: empty tall amber glass water tank, plain sides
images.why: Look 'A tank at the left'; Stage 'The tank stands at the left of the working area, 200 by 300, its pale blue water level drawn to that scale'; Student controls 'Tank: shows the level falling and rising'. The empty tank is the skin, the level and the litre marks are code.
images.prompt: A stout, broad water tank standing upright on a thick base, about one and a half times as tall as it is wide, with a wide rounded-rectangle body made of smooth, evenly tinted deep honey-amber glass, straight plain sides, a wide open top and a thick smooth rim. The same rich warm amber colour fills the whole tank, walls and inside alike.

images.object: squat amber glass jar with a wide open mouth, plain sides
images.why: Stage 'jars of one hundred, two hundred, two hundred and fifty and five hundred millilitres in a row'; Student controls 'Jar shelf'; 'A jar dipped in the bucket fills to its brim, and tipped over a bottle it pours'. One jar skin at four sizes; the water inside is code.
images.prompt: A short, round-bodied glass jar standing upright, shown from the side, made of smooth, evenly tinted deep honey-amber glass, with a thick base, a gently rounded shoulder, a short straight neck and a wide, open, smooth round rim. The same rich warm amber colour fills the whole jar.

images.object: tall copper water bottle, plain side
images.why: Stage 'a one litre and a two litre bottle beside them'; 'pours until it is empty or the bottle is full to its neck line'; Goal 'how many small jars fill a bottle'. Swapped (main session, 2026-10-22, visual review): the amber open-necked bottle read as a beer bottle; this is the chapter's copper WATER bottle (litre_jug's free library hit). The water, the neck line and the 1 L and 2 L names are code.
images.prompt: A tall slim copper water bottle with a screw cap, standing upright and seen from the side.
